description: These are property-level flood risk statistics from the First Street Foundation Flood Model version 2.0 for the 50 United States and Puerto Rico. The Zenodo record, published by the First Street Foundation on 13 April 2022, documents the CSV data and holds a sample file and a data dictionary. Each property has a First Street ID, coordinates and census and administrative codes, its Flood Factor (1 minimal to 10 extreme), economic loss data, flood depths in centimetres for 2-, 5-, 20-, 100- and 500-year events under low, medium and high climate scenarios for the current year and 30 years ahead, cumulative probabilities of exceeding 0, 15 and 30 centimetres, and information on historical events and flood adaptation. Aggregated statistics by congressional district, county and ZIP code allow comparison with FEMA data. Coverage: all properties in the 50 states and Puerto Rico. Access: the full data are requested from First Street; Zenodo has only the documentation and a sample. Licence: the Zenodo record is CC BY 4.0; terms for the full data were not read. Caveats: version 2.0 from 2022, with later versions announced. Simulation uses: parcel-level flood exposure under climate change. Related records: the USGS HERA exposure data.
